sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking for following reliefs:
(i) Issue Writ in nature of Mandamus directing respondents to consider Representation/application dated 18.05.2019 as per Annexure- M for release of amount along with pursuant toof petitioner as per Section 29(2) of KIAD Act, and by directing respondent to withdraw General Award amount deposited in Reference Court etc.
2.

Sri H.V. Devaraju, learned counsel for petitioner submitted that land measuring 03 acres 2 guntas including 2 guntas of Kharab in Sy.no.20/8 of Valagerehalli village, Kengeri Hobli, Bangalore South Taluk, belonged to their family.
Same was notified for acquisition under Preliminary Notification dated 23.06.1990 and Final Notification dated 13.05.1992 by respondent no.3 for benefit of respondent no.2.
It was submitted though on ground that there was dispute regarding title with regard to land under acquisition, compensation was deposited before Civil Court.

It was submitted though dispute was pending in O.S.nos.4496/2011, 5967/2011 and O.S.no.5969/2016,
O.S.no.4496/2011 and 5967/2011 were dismissed; while O.S.no.5969/2016 ended in compromise,
wherein respondents agreed for release of proportionate amount of compensation in favour of petitioner.
It was NC: 2023:KHC:45151 submitted that pursuant to same petitioner filed representation at Annexure- M on 18.05.2019 before respondent no.2 and same remained without consideration.
Therefore, petitioner has approached this Court seeking for direction.

3. On other hand, Sri Manu K., learned counsel for respondents no.1 and 2 submitted that in case petitioners representation had remained pending consideration, it would be considered in accordance with law within reasonable period.
4. Heard learned counsel and perused writ petition record.
5. From above, it is not in dispute that portion of land on which petitioner was claiming interest was acquired by respondent and award was passed.

Insofar as compensation, dispute with regard to title was settled with dismissal of O.S.nos.4496/2011 and 5967/2011 and compromise entered into in O.S.no.5969/2011 in terms of which petitioner had filed representation at Annexure-M.
